meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品网址或一段文案变成产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有产品要上线,需要一条宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product URL or brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product to launch and need a promo video

howto.what: 把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或需求做成产品发布/宣传视频:抓取网站素材、选设计预设、写分镜与脚本、逐帧生成画面,最后渲染出视频文件。网站导览与展示也按同一流程处理。
howto.when: 当你想推广、发布、宣传或揭晓一个产品时触发;任何商业网址默认走这条路,网站导览与展示也归此类。意图不明时先看 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用我们的官网做一个产品发布宣传视频
say.note: 会先抓取网站素材,再逐步确认分镜和脚本

say.text: 把这段脚本做成产品功能揭晓视频
say.note: 按脚本原文或用重组旁白生成画面

say.text: 给 acme.com 做一条 30 秒的产品宣传片
say.note: 时长作为大致预期,成片后按实际报告

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch or promo video: captures site assets, picks a frame preset, writes storyboard and script, builds frames, then renders the video. Site tours and showcases use the same flow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; any commercial URL is the default route, and site tours or showcases also land here. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a product launch promo video from our website
say_en.note: Captures the site first, then confirms storyboard and script

say_en.text: Turn this script into a feature reveal video
say_en.note: Uses the script verbatim or restructured narration
Length is an expectation; final cut is reported later
